title: CrabOS: An Operating System for Human-AI Co-inhabitation
description:
arXiv:2608.28165v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: AI agents are evolving into long-running computational entities that can invoke tools, maintain memory, and complete complex tasks across applications. In real-world settings, completing a task often requires humans and AI to take turns leading its execution. Such alternation depends on the seamless handoff of the work state of the task between humans and AI. Existing agent systems, however, provide humans and AI with separate work environments.
